purpose: A moving shot that carries the story between lines: walking, arriving, working, travelling. Fixes the F12 near-still clips.
camera_default: [Tracking shot] or [Truck left]/[Truck right] matched to the subject's direction
direction_rule: Subject motion and camera motion are written as two sentences with their own direction words; when both move, say they move the same way at the same speed or name the difference.
beats_pattern: enter/start position -> mid-path detail (glance, prop) -> reach end position -> held last frame
motion_floor: motion_score >= 0.02 (MOTION_SCORE_LOW) or the clip is flagged CLIP_LOW_MOTION before assembly
